fields.name: sourceName
fields.description: Free-form name of the upstream source this run imported from.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle position of the import run.

fields.name: rowCount
fields.description: Number of rows staged for review.

fields.name: errorCount
fields.description: Number of rows the host parser flagged with errors during staging.

fields.name: mappingJson
fields.description: Source-column → target-field mapping (JSON string), recorded verbatim from config for provenance; the atom applies it when parsing staged rows on confirm.

events.name: BATCH_CREATED
events.description: import_batches persist-create success — rebinds @entity.id to the server-issued id, the fallback for when the host didn't mint a client-side batchId on UPLOAD_CSV

events.name: ROWS_STAGED
events.description: import_rows bulk persist-create success signal — payload carries the persisted rows flat; the atom never reads it (self-loop only)

events.name: IMPORT_PERSIST_FAILED
events.description: Any import_batches / import_rows persist failure — the batch row is updated to failed and IMPORT_FAILED emitted, never a silent swallow; the trait stays put so the user can retry or discard

events.name: IMPORT_CONFIRMED
events.description: The user confirmed the staged review and the batch row is persisted as confirmed. The atom then fetches the batch's staged rows, parses and key-maps them, and emits IMPORT_ROWS_PARSED for the consumer's persist half.
events.synonyms: import confirmed, commit import, accept staged rows, approve import

events.name: IMPORT_ROWS_FETCHED
events.description: import_rows collection-fetch success on confirm — payload carries every staged row flat; the atom filters to @entity.id by batchId in the IMPORT_ROWS_PARSED arm (self-loop only)

events.name: IMPORT_ROWS_PARSED
events.description: Confirmed rows parsed and key-mapped: each staged row's rowJson was parsed via json/parse and remapped through the batch's mappingJson; failed counts rows whose rowJson did not parse to an object (surfaced, never dropped). The consumer persists rows into its own target entity and marks them imported.
events.synonyms: rows parsed, rows mapped, import rows ready

events.name: IMPORT_FAILED
events.description: The run failed (persist failure or empty staging); error carries the detail and the batch row was updated to failed
events.synonyms: import failed, upload failed, staging failed

events.name: UPLOAD_CSV
events.description: Starts an import run for a CSV file upload. batchId is the client-minted batch id (idempotent upload — the host generates it so a retry never double-creates a batch); when omitted, the server-issued id is bound on BATCH_CREATED instead. The host's file UI (e.g. a sibling std-import menu) only announces the upload — parsing is host work and arrives as STAGE_ROWS.
events.synonyms: upload csv, import csv, start import, import file, bulk import

events.name: STAGE_ROWS
events.description: Host-side CSV parsing finished: rows carries one JSON string per parsed row (raw source shape, pre-mapping); errorCount counts rows the parser flagged. The atom bulk-persists them into import_rows and opens the staged review.

events.name: DISCARD_IMPORT
events.description: The user discarded the staged run before confirm; the batch row stays for provenance.

events.name: CONFIRM_IMPORT
events.description: The user approved the staged review; the batch is marked confirmed, IMPORT_CONFIRMED fires, and the atom parses+maps the staged rows into IMPORT_ROWS_PARSED for the consumer's persist half.
events.synonyms: confirm import, approve staged rows, accept import

events.name: RESET
events.description: Returns the atom to idle from a terminal state

overridableConfigKeys.label: Field mapping (JSON)
overridableConfigKeys.description: JSON object mapping source CSV column names to target field names. Stored verbatim on the batch row (mappingJson); the atom applies it when it parses staged rows into IMPORT_ROWS_PARSED, so the consumer persists already-mapped rows into the target entity.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: field mapping, column mapping, map columns, remap fields, csv columns

overridableConfigKeys.label: Historical data range (days)
overridableConfigKeys.description: How many days back an import may reach (0 = unbounded). A declared import-config knob for the consumer's staging/mapping layer — the atom stages whatever rows it is handed and never filters by date.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: history window, historical range, import range, days back, lookback period

overridableConfigKeys.label: Source name
overridableConfigKeys.description: Free-form name of the upstream source this import pulls from — whatever tool or file export the user names. Recorded on the batch row for provenance and echoed on IMPORT_CONFIRMED.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: source, origin, import from, provider name, data source

overridableConfigKeys.label: Target entity
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name of the consumer organism's entity the staged rows land in after confirm. Declarative contract only — the atom never writes the target entity; the consumer persists on IMPORT_CONFIRMED.
